caption: The drawing shows a long-handled tool with a horizontal bar at one end, from which seven evenly spaced tines extend downward. The tines are forked at the bottom, each splitting into two points. The handle is shown attached to the horizontal bar with a joint mechanism, which is depicted in detail. The handle is elongated and cylindrical, shown in a perspective view to the right, and parallel views above; two side-view technical illustrations of the tool are provided at the top of the image, one of which includes a loop at the back end of the handle. A small linear scale marked “0 in” to “12 in” is located below the side-view illustrations. The entire composition is rendered in pencil or graphite with varying shades of gray outlining the structure and providing some shading and dimension against a plain light background.
title: Wrought Iron Toaster
